features.name: three parallel combat lanes
features.notes: Classically three parallel routes, all legible in one view.
features.quote: Lane Network: Parallel routes, classically three

features.name: distinct lane boundaries
features.notes: Routes visibly separated to channel traffic into predictable fronts.
features.quote: channelling team traffic into predictable engagement fronts

features.name: lane pinch points
features.quote: Lane Pinch Point: Narrow transitions where lanes meet

features.name: waist high cover arrays
features.notes: 3–4 studs high, distributed evenly across every lane.
features.quote: Waist-high (3–4 studs) and full-body (7–8 studs) cover distributed evenly across every lane

features.name: full body cover arrays
features.notes: 7–8 studs high, distributed evenly across every lane.
features.quote: Waist-high (3–4 studs) and full-body (7–8 studs) cover distributed evenly across every lane

features.name: undead enemy vehicles
features.notes: Vehicles drive through the world toward the player.
features.quote: creepy zombie-themed enemy vehicles that drive toward them through the world

features.name: unique detailed vehicle models
features.notes: Each enemy vehicle should have a distinct detailed 3D design.
features.quote: Each enemy vehicle must be a unique, detailed 3D model

features.name: creepy undead vehicle styling
features.notes: Applies to cars, tanks, or similar vehicle forms; no humanoid zombies.
features.quote: vehicles (such as cars or tanks) with an undead/creepy look, not humanoid zombies
